description_en: Adds a destination address to a targeted group
description_zh: 定向分组新增目标地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkcard add-directional-address --group-id 10000002595 --source user_defined --address-type Domain --address 0.aliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDirectionalAddress

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:

user_defined: user-defined configuration.
aliyun_defined: Alibaba Cloud predefined configuration
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型：

客户配置： user_defined

阿里云预配：aliyun_defined
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination address type. Valid values:

Ip: IP address.
Domain: domain name
parameters.help_zh:
目标地址类型：

Ip：Ip

域名：Domain
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en: The request number. This parameter supports idempotence
parameters.name: serial_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to push a notification through MQ after successful execution. Default value: false. Valid values:
false: does not push a notification.
true: pushes a notification (currently not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
执行成功后是否通过MQ推送，默认false：
false：不推送
true： 推送（目前不支持）
parameters.name: msg_notify

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly add a detected high-risk domain name. By default, the domain name is blocked and not added
parameters.help_zh: 检测到的高危风险域名是否强制添加，默认被拦截，不添加
parameters.name: url_insecurity_force

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: The call is successful.
Other values: The call failed. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：调用成功。

其他：调用失败。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the address is added. Valid values:

true: The address is added.
false: The address failed to be added
Data.description_zh:
地址是否添加成功。

true：添加成功。

false：添加失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
